verdict.rationale: Skyvern has a public pricing page and documents plans and credit tracking. That points to a published, credit-based pricing model, but the evidence shows no actual per-task or per-browser-hour prices. The "organization limits" mention describes limits a customer configures, not documented rate or concurrency limits. Missing for 10: concrete per-task/per-browser-hour price figures, documented API rate limits, documented concurrency limits, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
